name: Recoverable responsive reduction
summary: When narrow composition reduces concurrent panels, task-needed content and actions remain discoverable and accessible through relocated views or usable disclosure.
problem: Hiding a region for space may remove the only route to task completion even when visual layout appears cleaner.
context: Multi-region workflows where small viewports cannot comfortably display every region concurrently.
observed_solution: Distinguish critical/supporting/optional content; move or stack nonessential panes, or offer explicit alternate views/disclosure for necessary functions instead of silently removing them.
rationale: Primer describes fully functional responsive multi-view experiences (W04-O22); WAI supports header/navigation adaptation (O11); WCAG SC 1.4.10 requires no loss of information/functionality under scoped test conditions (O05), while pinned code shows hidden/position capabilities, not safe use (O29,O32).
tradeoffs: Extra view transitions can make cross-pane comparisons slower.
Visibility versus discoverability depends on actual navigation labels and task context.
applicability: Secondary panes or controls still needed in a workflow but unable to fit simultaneously.
non_applicability: Content truly not applicable in the narrow workflow.
Intrinsically side-by-side workflows that legitimately require a different 2D interaction model.
accessibility_implications: Check programmatic structure, keyboard access to disclosure, focus continuity and reflow; no conformance proven.
performance_implications: No performance data; additional view switching and mounted panels require separate testing.
responsive_implications: Layout reduction must not turn needed functionality into unrecoverable absence.
implementation_notes: Not an endorsement of a specific disclosure component, routing or frontend framework.
Do not treat a bare responsive hidden prop as evidence of accessible recovery.

counterexamples.summary: Decorative/irrelevant sidebar content can be hidden without an explicit disclosure if it is not required for any task.

version_context: WCAG 2.2 Recommendation 2024; Primer docs live unpinned; pinned PageLayout@7f5303d803986887187d86dcebaeda22a4dc6823
